arStrings.szText: For the next {c_number}60{/c} minutes, all enemies in the overworld have their Monster Power increased by {c_number}+1{/c}.

Stacks up to 3 times.

This works for any region in Sanctuary, but excludes Dungeons, Infernal Hordes, The Pit, Undercity, Cellars, or anything within an instance.
